More detailed information on the hierarchy of the regulatory factors during onset and reversal of ketogenesis has been obtained
for the fasting state by measurements at short time intervals. The ﬁrst event after withdrawal of food is a lowering of plasma insulin
accompanied by an increase in plasma fatty acids (stimulation of lipolysis). However, for an appreciable period (8–10 h) there is no
